verdict.rationale: Bland is a voice AI phone-agent platform, so barge-in handling is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions interruptions, barge-in, stopping speech mid-utterance, or recovering the turn. Pathways, memory, testbed and voice docs cover other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn
